gripOrHq.title: Corolla Speed Chip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Corolla Speed Chip when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using killers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: R&D Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Remove a tag, at no cost. You may pay [1] when you play Open-Ended® Mileage Program to take it back into your hand instead of trashing it.

heapOrArchives.title: HQ Interface

scoreArea.title: Corporate War
scoreArea.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

rig.title: Big Frackin' Gun
rig.rulesText: [6]: Break up to five sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: “Armadillo” Armored Road Home
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Armored Road Home when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn. [T]: Prevent up to 3 meat damage.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
rig.rulesText: Gain [1] after each successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

scoreArea.title: Artificial Security Directors
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Black Ops agendas is reduced by 1.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 6 - If trace is successful, end the run, trash a piece of hardware, and do 2 meat damage. This damage cannot be prevented.

ice.title: Fatal Attractor
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.
